latestTerminalSummary:
Round 21 fails the target-9 bar, narrowly: 11 of my 12 scores are 9, but Responsive visual polish is 8.5 in both light and dark.

| Category | Light | Dark |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Typography | 9 | 9 |
| Composition and spacing | 9 | 9 |
| Color harmony | 9 | 9 |
| Contrast and emphasis | 9 | 9 |
| Component visual consistency | 9 | 9 |
| Responsive visual polish | **8.5** | **8.5** |

**The one material finding is new: Share opens part-way down the sheet on short phones.** At 320×640, opening Share puts focus in the People field, which scrolls the sheet body 351px. The first thing you see is the header above a cut-off "Replace link" button. The notice, the link checkbox and the link field are all out of view. At 390×844 the same focus causes no scroll, so the problem only shows on short or narrow phones. On a real phone, focusing a text field on open would probably also raise the keyboard. I couldn't confirm that, because I only tested emulated viewports in Chromium. The fix is to keep the sheet at its top when it opens: focus the heading, Close, or the first checkbox, or use `preventScroll`. On touch devices, don't put focus in a text field at all.

**The round 20 repairs all held up when I checked them live:**
- **Posture popover:** on the card and in the viewer it now uses the normal helper text size and section headings, flips upward when there's no room below, and no longer makes the page taller.
- **Version history (1280):** dates and buttons line up across rows.
- **Tag colour row:** sits flush with the field edges at 1280 and 320.
- **Phone layouts:** Filters uses the shared sheet layout, the Paste note sits above the buttons, and the tab labels wrap evenly.
- **Card menu button:** now properly centred at 1280.
- **Share sheet:** scrolls correctly, and its lower section is complete in dark.
- **Find/Replace panel:** rows are aligned.

**A few small leftovers don't hold any category down on their own:**
- One Share helper ("Embed tile") still uses the older grey.
- In the editor's Tags panel at 1280, "Add" is 44px tall while "Create and add tag" is 36px.
- One read-only sentence is repeated inside Share.
- The card's sharing icon has a smaller tap area than the menu button next to it.

I checked all four widths in both schemes and confirmed the colour scheme took effect each time. I didn't re-check code completion, source selection, the URL and Agent add modes, the admin users page, or long or unusual data. Everything I opened was closed without saving and my tab is closed. The only file I wrote is the report.

This is one reviewer's result, so it doesn't decide whether the round passes.

Files are in `docs/reviews/Exh-zrjo`:
- round-21-opus-visual.md
